Title: Osney Bridge towpath closure Oxford
Description: Towpath closed approximately 150 yards before Osney Bridge. Diversion via Abbey Road and Botley Road. Related to Thames Water trunk main replacement and bridge structural work.

Title: Marsh Lock footbridge closure Henley-Shiplake
Description: Footbridge closed south of Henley-on-Thames due to safety concerns. Diversion via A4155 pavements for approximately 3 miles (1.5 hours walk). Remains closed as of Jan 2025.

Title: Swinford Bridge footpath closure
Description: Thames Path closed at Swinford Bridge from 20 February 2025 until 12 September 2026 for structural repairs. Diversion route available.

Title: Abingdon Weir walkway closure
Description: Walkway across weir closed due to corrosion. Path re-routed via Abingdon town centre. May reopen if river levels are low but closes again with rising water levels.

Title: Temple Footbridge closure near Marlow
Description: Footbridge closed since May 2023 due to safety concerns and poor deck condition. Diversion via Temple Lane, Marlow Road, and Bisham Road. Rejoins at Causeway in Marlow.

Title: Runnymede Bridge 142 footbridge closure Egham
Description: Footbridge south of Runnymede Bridge/M25 closed since early 2024 due to structural damage from flooding. Diversion via A308 and A30 paths. Expected to last until at least 2026.

Title: Bell Weir Lock diversion Runnymede
Description: Small diversion at Runnymede Pleasure Grounds due to works on Bell Weir lock. Divert around compound with standing machinery, keeping it on left to return to river.

Title: Streatley-Goring towpath diversion
Description: Half mile (0.8km) diversion away from Thames due to eroding towpath south of Goring/Streatley Bridge. Riverside route unlikely to reopen until late 2026 at earliest.

Title: Penton Hook Island closure Staines
Description: Island remains closed to public since July 2025 due to diseased trees (ash dieback). Trees pose high risk from falling branches and collapsing trees. Specialist equipment needed for tree removal.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge closure Faringdon
Description: Bridge closed since March 2024 between Rushey and Shifford locks near Buckland village due to numerous structural and safety concerns.

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal disruption
Description: Left bank path blocked on left bank of Grand Union Canal between bridge over River Brent and Brentford Marina. Divert via alternative route or Brentford High Street.
